items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: And there wasn't a ballad singer who came to the top until Billy Eckstein. ... Just like Frank Sinatra or something.

ctx.x: And so they have a scene where I ask Ingrid Bergman if she can still hum the tune like she did in the movie, and she starts humming 'As Time Goes By,' and then I start playing it on the piano, and in the door walks unannounced and a complete surprise to Ingrid Bergman -- Frank Sinatra singing the song, 'As Time Goes By.' As part of the general tribute to Ingrid Bergman, and that was shown on December 6th on the CBS network.
And I think that's about all the special work I've done since I've seen you, Milt. Otherwise, it's just been the Plaza Bar work.
